before.term: Grade of previous febrile-neutropenia episode (current or historical as stated; CTCAE grade)
before.guidance: Grade the named event using its own CTCAE criteria; distinguish current findings from previous episodes.

grades.description: No other non-haematological adverse event.
Grade 1 under the named CTCAE term: generally mild or asymptomatic, with observation only and no intervention indicated.
Grade 2 under the named CTCAE term: generally moderate; local/non-invasive intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.
Grade 3 under the named CTCAE term: severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care activities may be limited.
Grade 4 under the named CTCAE term: life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

before.note: This field is explicitly tied to CTCAE v5.0 metadata in the encoded protocol. The current NCI release is v6.0, but SACTCheck will not silently reinterpret a source rule against a different CTCAE version.

after.version: NCCP 00463 v4 Table 4 prior febrile-neutropenia bands
after.term: Grade documented for the previous febrile-neutropenia episode
after.guidance: Review the previous episode record, including contemporaneous neutrophils, temperature, clinical severity and the grading system used. Table 4 distinguishes grade 4 from consideration for grade 3, and later recurrence despite G-CSF. Current febrile neutropenia or suspected sepsis belongs in the separate urgent current-event field; current normal counts do not erase prior history.
after.sourceLabel: NCCP 00463 v4 Table 4 prior febrile-neutropenia bands

grades.description: No previous febrile-neutropenia episode recorded; this is not a severity grade for an active episode.
No grade 1 febrile-neutropenia criterion is supplied in Table 4; verify the historical classification rather than using a generic mild-toxicity description.
No grade 2 febrile-neutropenia criterion is supplied in Table 4; verify the historical classification rather than using a generic moderate-toxicity description.
Previous episode documented as grade 3; confirm its recorded criteria and source grading system.
Previous episode documented as grade 4; confirm its recorded criteria and source grading system.

after.note: The NCCP table names grade 3 and grade 4 action bands but does not define their criteria or identify a CTCAE edition. Do not equate the episode grade with an ANC-only neutropenia grade or apply v5/v6 haematology bands automatically. Values 1 and2 are not defined by this source table.
